method: Web research 2026-10-15 from search-engine summaries of the cited pages (pages not opened directly).
overview: Ramp is a fast-growing New York fintech selling corporate cards and spend-management software. Strategy-type roles are in strategy and operations, business operations and finance teams at a startup scale.

differentiators.text: Operates with OKRs and team-based strategic planning; strategy and operations roles work close to product and leadership.

employee_support.text: US postings list parental leave of up to 16 weeks (birthing plus bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding) at full pay, and a fertility HRA of up to $10,000 a year.
employee_support.significance: Concrete, documented leave and family-building support.

employee_support.text: Built In lists unlimited PTO and annual education reimbursement.
employee_support.significance: Unlimited PTO's value depends on norms.

flexibility.text: In-office preference: new hires expected at least 3 days a week in NYC, SF or Miami.

tradeoffs.text: A culture profile reports 60+ hour weeks and 10-12 hour days as common (work-life balance rated 3.5).

unknowns: Structured training or mentorship for new grads.
